name: Maeda Yoshiki
source:
An ordinary second-year high school student.
Due to his parents getting their jobs relocated, the protagonist comes back to his birthplace after taking a 7 year leave and gets transferred to Baramon High School. 
You, the protagonist, will take part in this journey by meeting several characters, which will eventually lead into diverse sorts of situations.
translation:
An ordinary second-year high school student.
Due to his parents getting their jobs relocated, the protagonist comes back to his birthplace after taking a 7 year leave and gets transferred to Baramon High School. 
You, the protagonist, will take part in this journey by meeting several characters, which will eventually lead into diverse sorts of situations.
